name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing with temporary runtime storage and bounded sequential Reviewer cycles.

interface.shortDescription: Selective delivery with bounded sequential review and temporary state.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps planning, decisions and acceptance with Root. Solo is default; delegate uses one implementer. New audit/full tasks use at most two sequential Reviewer identities by default, configurable to any positive budget. A first ship can close immediately; corrections advance to the next fresh Reviewer, then reuse the last Reviewer once the budget is reached. Every review binds current bytes, inherited blockers and observed isolation. No automatic extra Reviewer or rewritten historical contracts. Full preserves the exact combined candidate and immutable evidence checks that fail closed.
defaultPrompt: For root startup, load only skill guidance, then declare the route before other task tools; never batch loading with task discovery. Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
